title: Reachability is not policy acceptance
method: Synthetic 20-device pilot. Full acceptance requires identity, routing and application policy checks. Twelve devices pass all checks; the other groups are mutually exclusive here. These values do not measure Cloudflare performance.
alt: Reachability is not policy acceptance. All required checks pass: 12 devices; Posture test fails: 5 devices; Route test fails: 3 devices. Illustrative values.
